name: HEX to RGB Converter
description: Convert colors between HEX and RGB instantly, with a live preview and a native color picker — no uploads, fully client-side.

faq.question: Does this support shorthand HEX like #f0c?
faq.answer: Yes — 3-digit shorthand (#f0c), 4-digit with alpha (#f0cf), 6-digit (#ff00cc), and 8-digit with alpha (#ff00ccff) are all accepted and normalized.

faq.question: Why doesn't the color picker show my alpha value?
faq.answer: The browser's built-in color picker (<input type="color">) only supports opaque 6-digit HEX colors — it's a platform limitation, not this tool's. The HEX and RGB text fields still support alpha; only the visual picker doesn't.

faq.question: What RGB value ranges are valid?
faq.answer: Each of red, green, and blue must be a whole number from 0 to 255.
